concept_prompt:
Create ONE full-body canonical concept of NOZINHO for our Brazilian living-kite monster game, on genuine transparent background. Reference 1 is identity only: Nozinho, the small friendly knot creature from the old sprite sheet. Reference 2 (Carcara central kite body) and reference 3 (Rabbito handmade paper) define the CURRENT visual style. Do not copy their anatomy.
IDENTITY: a compact round torso made from a tied interlaced knot of warm golden-cream kite string, turquoise face recessed in the central opening, two small looped knots on top, two short cord arms ending in small tied fists and two dangling cord legs ending in three tidy frayed string tips. The entire body construction is knot and kite cord, NOT a furry bear, and NOT a round plush toy. Two top loops are rope loops, not animal ears. Preserve cream/golden rope and turquoise face. No separate kite ornament, no wings, no mammal tail, no new accessories.
VIEW CRITICAL: clear THREE-QUARTER VIEW FACING RIGHT, about 30–40 degrees away from frontal. Show side depth of the knot on the viewer-left side; face plane turns right, far eye visibly smaller, far arm partially behind torso, near arm slightly larger. Both eyes visible. NO frontal symmetrical pose and no side profile. Slight hovering pose with dangling legs.
ART: handmade kite material, angular folded/twisted string facets, simple broad strands with a few visible braid seams, dark clean slightly stepped ink contours. 2 or 3 FLAT shadow planes per material, no smooth gradients or glossy volume. Small dark matte eyes like the Carcara reference, eyebrows/dark creases carry the friendly intent, tiny understated smile. No huge amber eyes, no white glassy highlights, no inflated mascot finish, no 3D look, no realistic textile fur. One discreet worn binding/repair in a strand, no generic decorative diamonds. Keep silhouette readable at game scale, charming and helpful rather than aggressive.
Single complete character only, centered with generous transparent padding, no ground shadow, no background, no checkerboard, no labels, no text. This concept will be split into central knot body and FOUR articulated cord limbs, so keep limb roots understandable and avoid tangles over the face.
parts_prompt:
Make an ANIMATION PARTS SHEET for this exact Nozinho concept. It is a friendly living knot of golden-cream kite cord, turquoise face, two rope loops, short cord arms with knot fists, two frayed cord legs. Preserve the exact THREE-QUARTER FACING RIGHT view in EVERY part and expression. Left visible side of knot is broad, far face side is compressed. Do not turn it frontal.
IMPORTANT STYLE CORRECTION: replace the large white/iris eyes of the draft with SMALL MATTE DARK EYES in the style of reference 2 Carcara. No white sclera, no eye highlights, no large iris. Eyes should be simple small dark paper-cut marks, each only around 5–8 percent of the FACE width, not the whole body. Friendly eyebrows and a tiny smile. Preserve golden cord facets, turquoise face, stitched repair. Clean outlined 2D handmade-paper facets, restrained flat shadows.
Output a square transparent sheet with an EXACT 3 COLUMNS × 3 ROWS layout, generous empty separation between pieces. Do not draw grid lines or labels. Every piece completely contained in its own slot, with transparent padding.
ROW 1:
Column 1: neutral CENTRAL KNOT BODY ONLY, including the two upper rope loops and turquoise face. NO arms, NO legs, NO dangling appendages. Complete lower cord ring. Short overlapping cord attachment regions on torso sides are fine.
Column 2: NEAR ARM, viewer-left arm, isolated. Same curled rope arm and round knot fist as the concept; root at upper-right extends into fist lower-left. Broad root designed to disappear under body rim.
Column 3: FAR ARM, viewer-right arm, isolated. Smaller/receding rope arm with round knot fist, root at upper-left and fist lower-right. Complete root.
ROW 2:
Column 1: NEAR LEG, viewer-left lower leg, isolated: short cord segment descending down-left from root at upper-right, ending in THREE thick tidy frayed string tips. No arm/fist.
Column 2: FAR LEG, viewer-right lower leg, isolated: short cord descending down-right from root at upper-left, THREE frayed tips; subtly narrower than near leg.
Column 3: SAME CENTRAL KNOT BODY AS ROW1 COLUMN1, same scale, camera, silhouette, loops, repair and turquoise face, NO LIMBS. Only facial marks change to FOCUSED action: small narrowed dark eyes and lowered eyebrows, no angry monster redesign.
ROW 3:
Column 1: SAME LIMBLESS KNOT BODY, same everything. Only facial marks change to HURT: small squeezed shut eyes and tiny wince.
Column 2: SAME LIMBLESS KNOT BODY, same everything. Only face changes to HAPPY: small closed curved eyes and tiny cheerful smile.
Column 3: completely EMPTY transparent.
Do not draw a complete assembled character anywhere. Exactly eight separated pieces/variants, no extra faces, no loose bits floating outside slots. Every body variant must have identical view, position and size inside slot; do not reshape the rope, mouth opening or loops. True transparent background, no checkerboard, no shadows on background, no text or labels. This sheet will be measured and rigged, not directly treated as a reliable grid.
